mcq.question: What does `compare_designs` find when it stores the result of `print_line_total(line)`?

options.A: The printed total as a string

mcq.explanation: Printing is a side effect, not a result. A function that only prints implicitly returns `None`, so callers cannot reuse the value.

mcq.question: What is the "pure core + I/O shell" design used by `render_invoice` and `show`?

options.A: Calculations return values; a thin outer layer does all printing
options.B: Every function prints its own result
options.C: All I/O happens inside the calculation functions
options.D: Output is written only to files

mcq.explanation: Pure functions are easy to test and reuse. Keeping printing at the edge (`show`) means you can switch to a file, a GUI or a web page without touching the maths.
